name: djaunt-overseer
description: Vertical tabs for Claude CLI sessions: group by ticket, suspend, and resume from any repo.

viewsWelcome.contents:
No pinned sessions yet.
[Browse all sessions](command:overseer.allSessions)
No repos yet. Pin a session or open a terminal in a git repo.

commands.title: Show Merged and Closed Pull Requests

overseer.views.core.description: Show the Core view. Decorative only.

overseer.views.dragon.description: Show the Djaunt view above Session. Decorative only.

overseer.views.office.description: Show the Office view below Session: a pixel guy for each session in the sidebar, working at his desk while the session is busy, wandering the office while it's idle, and asleep at his desk while it's suspended. Click a guy to open his session.

overseer.views.ticker.description: Show the hacker-status strip at the bottom of the Djaunt view. Decorative only.

overseer.views.errorEvents.description: Now and then, the Core and Djaunt views flash ERROR together. Decorative only.

overseer.views.hackEvents.description: Now and then, the Core and Djaunt views go to matrix rain and announce HACK SUCCEEDED together. Decorative only.

overseer.views.defenseEvents.description: Now and then, the Core and Djaunt views fight off an incoming hack together: alert, shields up, almost there, safe. Decorative only.

overseer.views.eventMinutes.markdownDescription: Average minutes between the Core and Djaunt views' scene events (ERROR, HACK, DEFENSE). Each gap is a random 0.6x to 1.6x of this. `0.5` is chaos, `60` is rare. Pick a preset with **Overseer: Set Event Frequency**.

overseer.sessionStatuses.markdownDescription: Statuses you can set on a session or terminal with **Set Status…**. A status tints the row's label and adds its badge. Edit them in **Overseer: Session Status Settings…**.

id.description: Stable id. Sessions keep their status by this id when the name changes.

icon.description: Codicon name, shown in the status picker and the row's tooltip.

badge.description: Up to two characters on the right of the row. Empty shows no badge.

asksReason.description: Ask for a reason when this status is set. The reason shows in the row's tooltip.

done.description: Marks the work finished. A session in this status is safe to kill and remove.

overseer.links.github.enabled.description: Show GitHub pull requests under each session.

overseer.links.jira.enabled.description: Show Jira tickets under each session.

overseer.links.artifacts.enabled.description: Show claude.ai artifacts under each session.

overseer.links.commits.enabled.description: Show commits in the Session sidebar.

overseer.links.prs.openOnly.description: Hide merged and closed pull requests in the Session sidebar. A PR with no known status still shows.

overseer.links.jira.baseUrl.description: Jira site for tickets whose URL the transcript doesn't show, e.g. https://acme.atlassian.net.

overseer.jira.mcpServer.description: Name of the stdio Jira MCP server in ~/.claude.json. Overseer starts it to read ticket status and move tickets.

overseer.analyzer.model.description: Model that groups a session's work into workstreams on each diff pass. Runs headless through the claude CLI.

overseer.analyzer.recheckModel.description: Model for Recheck from scratch, and the retry when a diff pass returns a reply that fails the schema.

overseer.analyzer.auto.description: Run an analysis pass on its own after a session goes idle. Off means only Update Now and Recheck from Scratch run passes.

overseer.analyzer.idleSeconds.description: Seconds a session must stay idle after a busy turn before an auto pass starts. Going busy again cancels the wait.

overseer.analyzer.minNewKb.description: KB of new transcript since the last pass that an auto pass needs. A new PR, ticket, or artifact link also counts.

overseer.analyzer.minNewPrompts.description: New user prompts since the last pass that an auto pass needs. 0 lets a session that works without new prompts (task notifications, wakeups, /loop) still update.

overseer.analyzer.cooldownMinutes.description: Minutes after any pass on a session, in any window, before an auto pass can run on it again.

overseer.theme.tabSpotlight.description: With an Overseer theme active, add tab colors to your user settings so the focused editor group's active tab gets the accent tint and edge. VS Code's modern UI only reads tab colors from settings. Your own values are kept.

overseer.links.liveStatus.description: Show live PR state through gh and Jira status through your Jira MCP server. Checked every five minutes for expanded sessions.

overseer.summary.model.description: Model for Summarize with Haiku. Runs only when you click it.

overseer.sessionIcons.working.markdownDescription: [Codicon](https://microsoft.github.io/vscode-codicons/dist/codicon.html) for a session that is working in this window. Set its color with `overseer.sessionWorking` in `workbench.colorCustomizations`, or in **Overseer: Session Icon Settings…**.

overseer.sessionIcons.compacting.markdownDescription: [Codicon](https://microsoft.github.io/vscode-codicons/dist/codicon.html) for a session that is compacting. Needs **Overseer: Install Compact Hooks**. Set its color with `overseer.sessionCompacting` in `workbench.colorCustomizations`, or in **Overseer: Session Icon Settings…**.

overseer.sessionIcons.running.markdownDescription: [Codicon](https://microsoft.github.io/vscode-codicons/dist/codicon.html) for a session that is running in this window. Set its color with `overseer.sessionRunning` in `workbench.colorCustomizations`, or in **Overseer: Session Icon Settings…**.

overseer.sessionIcons.elsewhere.markdownDescription: [Codicon](https://microsoft.github.io/vscode-codicons/dist/codicon.html) for a session that is running outside this window. Set its color with `overseer.sessionElsewhere` in `workbench.colorCustomizations`, or in **Overseer: Session Icon Settings…**.

overseer.sessionIcons.suspended.markdownDescription: [Codicon](https://microsoft.github.io/vscode-codicons/dist/codicon.html) for a session that is suspended. Set its color with `overseer.sessionSuspended` in `workbench.colorCustomizations`, or in **Overseer: Session Icon Settings…**.

overseer.sessionIcons.duplicate.markdownDescription: [Codicon](https://microsoft.github.io/vscode-codicons/dist/codicon.html) for a session that is more than one copy running. Set its color with `overseer.sessionDuplicate` in `workbench.colorCustomizations`, or in **Overseer: Session Icon Settings…**.

default.name: Check PR Reviews
default.prompt: Latest reviews are in on the PR. Pull them and evaluate.

default.name: Monitor AI Code Reviews
default.prompt: Start monitoring for new AI code reviews, address them as they land.

overseer.sessionCommands.markdownDescription: Prompts you can send to an idle session with **Commands…** (right-click a session). Write `{name}` in a prompt to be asked for that value first, like `Start triage for: {ticket link}`.

prompt.description: Sent to the session. Use {name} for a value to ask for.

overseer.office.scene.markdownDescription: The Office view's room. Switch it with **Overseer: Switch Office Scene…** or the button on the view.

overseer.office.sleepers.description: Give suspended sessions in the sidebar a guy too, asleep at his desk. Off shows only running sessions.

overseer.office.critters.description: Every so often a few critters for the scene run across the Office: mice in the office, foxes and rabbits in the forest, chickens in the field, ducks and frogs by the river, bats in the cave, little aliens on the moon. Idle guys stop to watch.

overseer.office.dayNight.description: Light the Office by your clock: sunrise, golden hour, sunset, and night, with the sun and the real phase of the moon in the sky. Outdoor scenes get dark at night and screens and fires light up around them; the office keeps its lights on; the server room and the cave never see the sky. On the moon a day lasts a month. Off keeps it daytime.

enumDescriptions: Someone every 8 to 30 seconds. The room fills up.
overseer.office.visitors.description: How often people from other departments (sometimes a manager) drop into the Office. Up to five hang around at once: some say something and leave, others stay a minute or two, and some settle in for a good while to chat, get coffee, and loom over busy guys. Each guy answers in his own way: the suck-up says "OK BOSS!", the reasonable ones grumble.

overseer.office.portraits.markdownDescription: Show each session's pixel guy as its row icon in Sessions and Terminals, with the session's state as a badge in his corner. Turn off to use the `overseer.sessionIcons.*` codicons. Re-roll a guy from the row's menu.

overseer.office.you.markdownDescription: Put you in the Office: your own guy at a two-monitor station in the middle of the room, who reacts to the ERROR, HACK, and DEFENSE scene events along with his monitors. Set his look with `#overseer.office.yourLook#`.

overseer.office.yourLook.markdownDescription: Your guy's look in the Office. Leave a field out for the default: a blonde ponytail with one side shaved, blue eyes, a thick orange beard, a black muscle shirt, white shorts, and black flip flops. Colors are `#rrggbb`.

beard.description: Beard color, when the accessory is a beard or full beard.
